Thanks for the review. I will update this PR to include:

1. A functional changelog generator script (`generate_changelog.py`) that parses git history since the last tag.
2. Auto-categorization logic mapping commits to Added/Fixed/Changed/Removed sections based on conventional commit prefixes.
3. A README with ≤3-step setup instructions.
4. Sample output generated from a real repository included in the updated PR description.

Expected update within 48 hours.
risks: PR may be closed if fix takes too long and another contributor submits a complete solution first
Generator must handle edge cases (no tags, empty history) to pass review
Sample output must be verifiable against a real repo to avoid rejection
